runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies to new AI contracts awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of the memorandum. The same 180-day mark applies to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract.

The trigger is the solicitation date, not the award date. A contract awarded after day 180 but under a solicitation issued earlier would not be covered, based on the wording above.

Its predecessor, M-24-18, used the same 180-day window for "other contracts for AI" (the same 180 days after issuance language). The passages do not say whether M-25-22 replaces M-24-18.
